question: Where do I submit and by when?

notice.title: MERIT-CUM-MEANS SCHOLARSHIP 2026-27
notice.summary: Applications are open for the Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for the 2026-27 academic year. Eligible enrolled students must meet specific criteria regarding academic performance and family income. Applicants can submit their completed forms and required documents either physically at the Scholarship Office or online before the deadline.
notice.eligibility: Minimum 75% aggregate in the last completed examination, Family annual income below Rs. 8,00,000, Minimum 75% attendance in the current semester
required_documents: Mark sheet of the last examination

action_items.detail: Ensure minimum 75% aggregate, family income below Rs. 8,00,000, and 75% attendance.
Gather self-attested copies of Mark sheet, Income certificate/ITR, and Caste certificate (if applicable).
Submit the completed form either physically to the SCHOLARSHIP OFFICE or online via the provided link.
Ensure submission is completed on or before 15 November 2026, 4:00 PM.

notice.answer: You can submit your application either physically or online. Physical submissions must be made to the SCHOLARSHIP OFFICE, located in the Admin Block, Room 12. The deadline for submission is strict: applications must be received on or before 15 November 2026, 4:00 PM. Alternatively, you can register online using the provided link: https://example.edu/scholarship/apply.
